doc: A single float32 latitude of 0.5 rad (28.6 degrees, Hadley 30): the smallest legal shape. Tolerance is the golden float32 default. Measured: promoting the float32 inputs to float64 changes the output by at most 5.8e-8; one-ulp nudges of every float input and parameter change it by at most 6.0e-8 (worst of 6 random trials); the tolerance is about 2e2x the larger of the two spreads.
